title: pvText
body:
## pvText

Source that produces a one-row, one-column table whose Text column holds the whole Text string as a single cell; the string is not split. ParaView's help describes '|' as a column separator and newlines as rows, but that applies to ParaView's text display of the table, not to the table vtkPVTextSource outputs. Use it for titles, captions or a fixed label; use pvAnnotateTime or pvAnnotateAttributeData for text derived from time or data.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The output table has exactly one cell, so table filters downstream see one string whatever punctuation or line breaks it contains.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Text`. Identity: `sources/TextSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Text` | This property specifies the text to display. To display text separated into cells, use newlines to separate text into rows and the '\|' (pipe) character to create columns. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvText"
}
```
